gold.text: The system must display the "last active time" and operation records of each device in real time.
Users can use the status filter to filter out devices as "offline", "idle" or "running" with a single click.

When adjusting values ​​such as brightness or temperature, the system must set reasonable upper and lower limits (thresholds) to prevent illegal parameters from being sent.
The scheduling function must have conflict detection. If two scheduled tasks issue conflicting instructions to the same device at the same time, the user should be alerted.
The brightness adjustment function can only be used on lighting equipment, not on thermostats or other types of equipment.
The temperature control function can only be used on thermostat-type devices, and not on lamps or other types of devices.
The status of the equipment needs to be changed in real time according to the equipment's power on/off status.
